text:
jia (PM): Quick sync: looking for UX signoff on Deployments & Rollouts page. Areas: timeline scrubber, canary scheduler, A/B labels, rollback modal copy + accessibility. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/rollouts-ux. Please comment by EOD.

deploy-bot: Staging preview available: https://preview.redwood.ai/rollouts/8472 (build #8472)

omar (Design): Main feedback: timeline feels dense when expanded. Proposal: collapsed state that shows a compressed summary row; expand on click. Add thin vertical markers for canary start/end and scheduled steps. Change CTA text from "Start canary" to "Start canary rollout" for clarity.

leo (FE): Implementation notes: lazy-load large diffs when user requests them. Scrubber needs keyboard support: Left/Right arrows 1%, Shift+Arrows 5%, Home/End jump. We should announce scrubber percent to screen readers via polite aria-live.

nina (Accessibility): A11y checklist: ensure 44px hit target for scrubber thumb, contrast for tick labels >= 4.5:1, tooltips must be focusable, modals trap focus and return it. Live region should announce percent changes only when user changes value, not on every render.

sasha (Platform): For A/B variants show short stable IDs (e.g., v5 · b2c3) and link to experiment metrics. Also display traffic split as both percent and approximate request counts (e.g., 15% ~ 150 req/min) so PMs have context.

mar (SRE): Rollback modal must call out streaming/in-flight behavior. Suggested copy: "Rolling back to v4: new traffic will route to v4. Existing streaming sessions may continue on current instances for up to 3 minutes." For major infra rollbacks require typing full commit hash; for simple config rollbacks a checkbox confirming intent is fine.

omar (Design): UX question: default focus in confirmation modal -> safer default is Cancel. For destructive actions require an explicit confirm (typing or checkbox). I'll prototype two variants in Figma: type-to-confirm and checkbox flows.

leo (FE): Also add a small inline timeline preview in the modal (3 ticks) so users can see immediate effect. Diffs should support copy-to-clipboard and show a small "Size: 24KB" hint before loading.

nina (Accessibility): For copy-to-clipboard, announce "Copied commit id" via aria-live. Ensure error state on confirm input is programmatically linked (aria-describedby).

sasha (Platform): Canary scheduler: allow chaining steps (percent + duration). Presets: Quick ramp, Standard, Conservative. Show estimated impacted RPS per step. Also provide cancel/cutover controls.

omar (Design): Microcopy tweak: top nav -> "Deployments & rollouts" (better discoverability). Add a help pill next to canary: two-line explainer + link to docs.

jia (PM): Action items: 1) Design: collapsed timeline + modal variants (omar). 2) FE: keyboard scrubbing, lazy diffs, modal preview (leo). 3) Platform: variant IDs and RPS estimates (sasha). 4) SRE: rollback copy + runbook note about streaming sessions (mar). 5) A11y: contrast, hit targets, live-region patterns (nina). I'll create tickets and assign owners.

deploy-bot: Preview updated: https://preview.redwood.ai/rollouts/8473 (build #8473)

omar (Design): Will upload Figma updates and add microcopy changes by EOD.

leo (FE): I'll open a small PR with keyboard support and aria attributes tomorrow. cc @nina

sasha (Platform): I'll scope the API change for audit export and variant metadata.

nina (Accessibility): Happy to review once PR is up.

jia (PM): Thanks all 1: will follow up with tickets and assign reviewers.

omar (Design): LGTM

leo (FE): ack
